data.evidence_sentence: The Elsa-Neumann-Scholarship provides funding for doctoral researchers at the four Berlin universities.
data.notes: Academic performance 'far above average' is a verbal grade condition, usually shown by final degree grade; no numeric GPA. No nationality rule stated. No field restriction stated, so field left empty. Deadline 'November 11th' has no year and is past relative to 2026-11-21, so treated as annual; page may be outdated. Completion scholarships (max 12 months) are partial-length awards; full scholarships are up to 36 months. Page also describes unrelated museum tour events.
